crew.overview: Husband and wife Gabe and Adelaide Wilson take their kids to their beach house expecting to unplug and unwind with friends. But as night descends, their serenity turns to tension and chaos when some shocking visitors arrive uninvited.
crew.title: Us

crew.overview: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.
crew.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron

crew.overview: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.
crew.title: Thor: Ragnarok

crew.overview: What if mankind had to leave Earth and somebody forgot to turn the last robot off? After hundreds of years doing what he was built for, WALL•E discovers a new purpose in life when he meets a sleek search robot named EVE. EVE comes to realize that WALL•E has inadvertently stumbled upon the key to the planet's future, and races back to space to report to the humans. Meanwhile, WALL•E chases EVE across the galaxy and sets into motion one of the most imaginative adventures ever brought to the big screen.
crew.title: WALL·E

crew.overview: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.
crew.title: Black Panther

crew.overview: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.
crew.title: Doctor Strange

crew.overview: Dominic Toretto and his crew battle the most skilled assassin and high-performance driver they've ever encountered: his forsaken brother.
crew.title: F9

crew.overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.
crew.title: Captain America: Civil War

crew.overview: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-widening conspiracy while fighting off professional assassins sent to silence him at every turn. When the full scope of the villainous plot is revealed, Captain America and the Black Widow enlist the help of a new ally, the Falcon. However, they soon find themselves up against an unexpected and formidable enemy—the Winter Soldier.
crew.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier

crew.original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
crew.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
crew.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

crew.overview: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.
crew.title: Avengers: Endgame

details.biography:
Jeanie King is an Executive Visual Effects Producer and VP of Global Production at Industrial Light & Magic. In her senior leadership role, she oversees the entire spectrum of visual effects production, from budgeting and scheduling to creative staffing and coordination across ILM’s global studio network. She joined ILM in 1994 after gaining five years of experience in film and television production in Los Angeles.

Her early career highlights include her debut as a Features Visual Effects Producer on the film Jarhead (2005), which earned her and her colleagues a Visual Effects Society Award nomination in the category Outstanding Supporting Visual Effects in a Feature Motion Picture.

In addition to her work on Jarhead, Jeanie King co-produced the visual effects for Battleship (2012). That collaboration garnered a 2013 Saturn Award nomination from the Academy of Science Fiction, Fantasy & Horror Films (USA) in the Best Special Effects category, which she shared with Grady Cofer, Pablo Helman, and Burt Dalton.

Her talents extend beyond film into immersive and themed entertainment projects. She was part of the team behind Star Tours: The Adventures Continue (2011), a Special Venue project that earned a 2012 Visual Effects Society Award nomination for Outstanding Visual Effects in a Special Venue Project.

Beyond these nominations, Jeanie King is recognised as a member of prestigious industry organisations, including the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, the Visual Effects Society (VES), and the Producers Guild of America (PGA).
details.name: Jeanie King
